Hands-on tutorials for the workshop. Each one is a downloadable `.qmd` file with code, *Think about it* prompts, and collapsible answers — open it in RStudio, point the data paths at your local copy of the dataset (see [Datasets](Datasets.qmd)), and run it chunk by chunk.

::: callout-important
The download links below serve each tutorial as `Tutorial_XX_….qmd.txt`. After saving the file, **drop the trailing `.txt` so the filename ends in `.qmd`** before opening in RStudio. (The `.txt` suffix is a workaround that stops the browser from trying to render the source as a webpage.)
:::

## Core tutorial series — laptop path (`ifnb` + `stxBrain`)

Tutorials 01–09 use the **`ifnb`** dataset (Kang *et al.* 2017): \~14k cells across two samples (CTRL and IFN-β–stimulated PBMCs), \~25 MB, installed via `SeuratData::InstallData("ifnb")`. Tutorial 12 uses **`stxBrain`** (10x Visium mouse brain, two sections), \~50 MB, installed via `SeuratData::InstallData("stxBrain")`. Tutorial 05 uses the bulk `airway` dataset that ships with the `airway` Bioconductor package. Tutorials 10 (scATAC) and 11 (WGCNA) have their own datasets — see [Datasets](Datasets.qmd). The whole sequence runs comfortably on a laptop.

## Talapas Advanced — heavyweight HPC exercises

Once you've worked through the laptop tutorials, two parallel sets of exercises take you onto Talapas. They are designed to run as **R + SLURM jobs on the cluster**, not interactively on a laptop.

### A. NSCLC scaling exercise (Talapas)

Re-runs Tutorials 01–03 on the larger 10x 20k NSCLC DTC dataset (\~250 MB, 7 donors, real CMO multiplexing) so you can see the same workflow at production scale.

| Tutorial | View | Download |
|---|---|---|
| NSCLC 01 — QC & Preprocessing on 20k cells | — | <a href="Exercise_Folder/NSCLC_FullDataset/Tutorial_NSCLC_01_QC_Preprocessing.qmd.txt" download="Tutorial_NSCLC_01_QC_Preprocessing.qmd">Tutorial_NSCLC_01_QC_Preprocessing.qmd</a> |
| NSCLC 02 — Dim Reduction & Clustering | — | <a href="Exercise_Folder/NSCLC_FullDataset/Tutorial_NSCLC_02_DimReduction_Clustering.qmd.txt" download="Tutorial_NSCLC_02_DimReduction_Clustering.qmd">Tutorial_NSCLC_02_DimReduction_Clustering.qmd</a> |
| NSCLC 03 — Markers & Annotation | — | <a href="Exercise_Folder/NSCLC_FullDataset/Tutorial_NSCLC_03_Markers_Annotation.qmd.txt" download="Tutorial_NSCLC_03_Markers_Annotation.qmd">Tutorial_NSCLC_03_Markers_Annotation.qmd</a> |

### B. Raw-data processing on Talapas (Cell Ranger)

Most of the workshop starts from `filtered_feature_bc_matrix/` because that's what your sequencing core hands you. These tutorials walk **upstream of that** — running 10x's Cell Ranger / cellranger-atac on raw FASTQs as SLURM batch jobs. Use these when you have your own raw 10x data, when you need to re-process with a newer reference, or when you need to handle non-standard chemistries.

| Raw scATAC-seq with `cellranger-atac count` | — | <a href="Exercise_Folder/Talapas_RawData/Tutorial_Talapas_RawData_ATAC.qmd.txt" download="Tutorial_Talapas_RawData_ATAC.qmd">Tutorial_Talapas_RawData_ATAC.qmd</a> |

## Datasets used

Full dataset descriptions, install / download instructions, and a disk-space budget live on the **[Datasets](Datasets.qmd)** page.

Primary sources:

-   **scRNA-seq (laptop, Tutorials 01–04 + 06–09)** — [`ifnb`](https://satijalab.org/seurat/articles/integration_introduction.html) via `SeuratData::InstallData("ifnb")` (Kang *et al.* 2017, \~25 MB)
-   **DESeq2 primer (Tutorial 05)** — `airway` Bioconductor package (no manual download)
-   **scRNA-seq (Talapas scaling exercise)** — [10x Genomics: 20k NSCLC DTC, 3' v3.1 Multiplex](https://www.10xgenomics.com/datasets/20-k-mixture-of-nsclc-dt-cs-from-7-donors-3-v-3-1-multiplex-3-1-standard-6-0-0) (use the **filtered** matrix — \~250 MB)
-   **scATAC-seq (Tutorial 10)** — [10x Genomics: PBMC 10k scATAC-seq v1](https://www.10xgenomics.com/datasets/10-k-peripheral-blood-mononuclear-cells-pbm-cs-from-a-healthy-donor-1-standard-1-1-0)
-   **WGCNA (Tutorial 11)** — [GEO: GSE152418 (COVID-19 PBMC bulk RNA-seq)](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE152418)
-   **Spatial transcriptomics (Tutorial 12)** — `stxBrain` (10x Visium adult mouse brain, anterior + posterior sections) via `SeuratData::InstallData("stxBrain")` (\~50 MB)

By convention the tutorials read from `../data/` (i.e. a `data/` folder at the repository root). For the `ifnb`-based laptop tutorials there's nothing to put in `data/` to start — the package handles the download. Place 10x downloads there or adjust the paths in the `Read10X*` calls.

## Adapted from

-   The `ifnb` workflow (Tutorials 01–04) follows the official [Seurat integration tutorial](https://satijalab.org/seurat/articles/integration_introduction.html), with workshop-specific commentary, *Think about it* prompts, and a four-tutorial pacing.
-   Tutorials 05 (Primer), 08 (scATAC), and 09 (WGCNA) follow the worked examples in [Khushbu Patel's YouTube Tutorials repo](https://github.com/kpatel427/YouTubeTutorials).
-   Pedagogical inspiration on QC pacing, marker plot ordering, and integration diagnostics: [scNotebooks](https://integrativebioinformatics.github.io/scNotebooks/) (Sengupta lab).
-   The NSCLC scaling exercise (`Exercise_Folder/NSCLC_FullDataset/`) follows Patel's `singleCell_standard_workflow.R` on the same 20k NSCLC dataset.
